question: Who of the following is an agricultural scientist who has played an important role in the green revolution in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monkombu Sambasivan Swaminathan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **M. S. Swaminathan** is widely recognized as the** father of the Green Revolution** in India.
 
• He played a crucial role in introducing high-yielding varieties of wheat and rice in India, which significantly increased the country's food production.
 
• His work in the field of agricultural science has led to **improved food security and reduced famine in India**.
 
• Swaminathan's efforts have been pivotal in transforming India's agricultural landscape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **C. Subramaniam** was the** Minister of Agriculture during the Green Revolution **and supported the movement but was not the scientist behind it.
 
• **Vikram Sarabhai** was a renowned space scientist and is known as the **father of the Indian space program**.
 
• **Verghese Kurien** is known as the **father of the White Revolution in India**, which transformed India's dairy industry.
